sources.entry: Usage4Claude - Real-time monitoring of Claude usage quotas across time windows and plans. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/f-is-h/Usage4Claude) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app that tracks Claude and Codex subscription usage quotas in real time.
summary.what_it_does: Shows 5-hour, 7-day, and Extra Usage/credits limits for Claude (claude.ai, Claude Code, desktop, mobile, Cowork) and 5-hour, 7-day, and credits limits for Codex (CLI, IDE extension, web) in the menu bar and a detail window. Offers Ring and Pace graph styles, where Pace compares usage against elapsed time, and can show per-model weekly usage for Claude. Sends system notifications at configurable thresholds and when quotas reset. Refreshes in Smart mode (adaptive) or Fixed mode (every 1, 3, 5, or 10 minutes), with backoff on rate limits. Supports multiple Claude accounts and organizations, browser-based sign-in or a manual Session Key, and an optional Codex reset announcement sourced from a third-party site.
use_cases: monitor Claude usage limits from the menu bar
get alerts before hitting a 5-hour or weekly limit
compare usage pace against elapsed time
switch between multiple Claude accounts or organizations
how_to_run: Download the latest .dmg from Releases and drag the app into Applications
Allow the first launch via System Settings → Privacy & Security (Open Anyway) or Control-click → Open
Grant Keychain access and choose Always Allow when prompted
git clone the repository and open Usage4Claude.xcodeproj in Xcode 26 or later
Press ⌘R in Xcode to build and run
notable: Monitors both Claude and Codex in one menu bar app, with per-service columns when both are configured
Pace graph style shows whether usage is ahead of or behind elapsed time, with optional weekdays-only weekly counting
Menu bar icons use distinct shapes and colors per limit type, plus a monochrome theme
Credentials stored in the Keychain; App Sandbox enabled; no server, analytics, or telemetry
Browser-based sign-in works with Google, Microsoft, enterprise SSO, and passkeys
caveats: Requires macOS 13 or later; build from source requires Xcode 26 or later
Free Claude accounts have no usage dashboard and cannot be read; Team and Enterprise need an admin to enable the member usage dashboard
Relies on undocumented APIs; the app is not on the App Store and is not notarized by Apple, so first launch needs manual approval
Codex reset announcement is a Beta feature using a third-party community site, not an official API
keywords: see how much claude i have left
